summary: Addressed the round-2 blockers in the saved-player sidebar: the selectable hit area now covers the full visible row body, and the compact one-line row layout is preserved when the sidebar stacks at narrower widths. Tests, docs, and the built `dist/` bundle were updated to match.
completed_work: Reworked saved-player row rendering so the row body (`#saved-player-row-body-*`) is the actual selection target, while the per-row delete button remains isolated.
Updated saved-player control wiring in `src/main.js` to toggle selection from the row body and support keyboard activation without changing load/save/result state behavior.
Tightened `src/styles.css` so saved-player rows stay horizontally compact with truncation under the `@media (max-width: 960px)` fallback instead of collapsing into stacked multi-line rows.
Updated `test/appFlow.test.js` and `test/responsiveLayout.test.js` to cover row-body selection and the non-stacked responsive contract.
Updated `README.md` and `FINAL_OUTPUT.md` to reflect the shipped row-wide selection and preserved one-line sidebar layout, then rebuilt `dist/`.

verification.result: Passed: rebuilt the static bundle in `dist/`.

known_gaps: Real browser/mobile smoke verification (`npm run test:browser`) was not run in this sandbox; docs still mark that gap as non-blocking for this round.
handoff_notes: The saved-player row selector used by the app-flow tests is now `#saved-player-row-body-{index}`; the old `#saved-player-toggle-*` id no longer exists.
The workspace was already dirty before this pass in `.harness/*`, `src/constants/copy.js`, and `dist/src/constants/copy.js`; those unrelated changes were left intact.
